history.summary: Freehold 2016 1BR in Lorong 20 Geylang (D14). The algo's -20.5% age-adj cheapness is a mirage: verified recent resales average $1,244 PSF (range $1,041-$1,340, high $1,340 Sep-2025) while this asks $1,495 PSF — ~12-20% ABOVE actual transactions. The 'psf_overpriced' flag and +16.4% cohort premium (on just 1 txn) are confirmed by the web.
history.rating_rationale: Web transaction data flatly contradicts the cheapness story: #1 Suites 1BR units sold over the last 12 months at $1,041-$1,340 PSF (avg $1,244), so the $1,495 PSF asking is 12-20% above market. The freehold age-adjustment that drives the algo's -20.5% figure is not a forward edge per v3.4 priors, and freehold is explicitly not a forward edge. Poor security reviews (no guard on site), only 112 units (thin liquidity), and a Geylang red-light-fringe location with no concrete MRT/zone catalyst compound the overpricing. This is a clear Avoid.
red_flags: Asking $1,495 PSF is ~12-20% ABOVE verified recent resales (avg $1,244, high $1,340 Sep-2025)
Algo 'psf_overpriced' flag confirmed; +16.4% cohort premium computed on a single transaction
Small 112-unit project and Geylang location limit liquidity and tenant pool quality
catalysts: Freehold tenure (a quality, but not a forward appreciation edge per backtest priors)
